name: Little Hoarder
storyline:
Stranded on an island after a disastrous honeymoon cruise, Fred—an unlucky everyman with a big heart and even bigger pockets—must scavenge, craft, and hoard his way back to something resembling a life. From shiny ores to suspicious carrots, everything has value... especially if you can carry it.

With nothing but a stubborn will, questionable fashion sense, and an inventory system that somehow holds trees, Fred turns survival into an obsessive collection quest. Build, upgrade, and maybe, just maybe, figure out why there's a guy in the forest watching you.
summary:
Betrayed and shipwrecked, Fred finds himself marooned on a mysterious island after a devastating betrayal by his wife.

Grief-stricken and with nothing left, he spirals into a manic obsession: collecting EVERYTHING. His island prison, surprisingly, possesses regenerative structures, seemingly designed to fuel his insatiable hoarding. Explore this bizarre paradise, uncovering its secrets and the strange mechanisms that replenish its seemingly endless resources. Unravel the mystery behind your solitary confinement and the bizarre technology that sustains it.

Discover the island's hidden depths, from sun-drenched beaches to dark, unexplored caverns, each brimming with potential treasures to add to your ever-growing collection. Will you find solace in your obsessive collecting, or will the island's secrets drive you further into madness? Will you uncover the truth behind your abandonment?
